# QCAT Sample Fixtures — Attribution

The `.txt` files in this directory are sample UE Capability Information outputs
captured with QCAT (Qualcomm's diagnostic log analyzer). They are copied
verbatim from the open-source [btminzon/bandcombination][1] project on GitHub.

[1]: https://github.com/btminzon/bandcombination

| File              | Device         | RAT  |
|-------------------|----------------|------|
| `G960W_LTE.txt`   | Samsung S9     | LTE  |
| `OnePlus9_LTE.txt`| OnePlus 9      | LTE  |
| `OnePlus9_NR.txt` | OnePlus 9      | NR   |
| `S22_LTE.txt`     | Samsung S22    | LTE  |
| `S22_NR.txt`      | Samsung S22    | NR   |

Used here as parser test fixtures. Original repository license applies to the
contents of these files.
